data.gender_notes: Farinaz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word "farang" which means foreign or foreigner and the Persian suffix "-az" which means possessor of. Farinaz is a name of Persian origin meaning possessor of treasures or jewels. In Persian culture, it is a name given to a girl who is believed to be a treasure or jewel to her family. The name Farinaz carries the meaning “Jewel, treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farinaz usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Farinaz holds a significant place in Persian culture as it symbolizes the value and significance of family. Unlike the Western naming conventions, the Persian naming tradition focuses more on familial and social identities rather than individual personalities. By giving their child such a beautiful and meaningful name, the parents are expressing their love and pride in their child as a treasure and jewel in their family. It is also a way of placing value on the traditions and cultures of their community and heritage.

The Quran states, "And We have only created man and jinn that they may serve us." (Adh-Dhariyat 51:56).
